_comment: Guard policy for the robinhood-trading MCP server. Allowlist model = default-deny: only the read/quote/history/review/scan tools below are exposed and callable; every order-placing or -cancelling tool (place_equity_order, place_option_order, cancel_equity_order, cancel_option_order) and every watchlist/scan mutation is denied by omission, and a new tool stays denied until added here. review_* are non-executing order previews, so they are allowed. redactPatterns scrub account numbers and any key/token from allowed responses.
